SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.
   C. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

4. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

5. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.
   B. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.
   D. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.
   B. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.
   D. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.
   C. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever

9. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.
   B. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.

10. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.
   B. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.
   C. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Population Growth in Africa.
   B. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
   B. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Human Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Improvement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Esteem Assessment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. C — Obeying laws and caring for public property

3. C — Explain symbols used on a map

4. B — Nairobi

5. D — Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. D — Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. A — Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. B — Plan income and spending wisely

9. B — Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. D — Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. D — Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. B — Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Human Rights; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Self- Esteem Assessment; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
